XCTF2K27
Cross country / Track & field
Faster. Further. Together.
  • Hold Space or → to push. In the last 0.4 mi, pushing becomes your kick.
  • Hold ← to ease off and win back energy.
  • ↑ ↓ switch lanes when someone boxes you in.
  • Press C during a race for first-person view. There, ↑ or W pushes, ↓ or S eases off, and ← → (or A D) change lanes.
  • Sit right behind a runner to draft and save about a quarter of your energy.
  • Hills and mud cost extra. Under 20% energy you fade.
  • Turn on random weather before a race: clouds speed everyone up, rain turns low spots to mud, snow slows the whole field.
  • Wind: some stretches are headwinds and some are tailwinds (the HUD tells you which). In a headwind, tuck in right behind someone: they block most of it and you save even more energy.
  • Once a school has 5 runners, its top five places add up to a team score. Lowest wins.
  • Track Quick Race: every event. 60 to 200 and the short hurdles: press Space on the gun (faster than 0.100 is a false start), then alternate ← → to drive. 300 and up: ↑ pushes and ↓ eases off, but your energy runs out fast. Space also jumps hurdles and steeple barriers (press when JUMP lights up) and leans at the line.
  • Relays: pick your leg. In the 4x100 and 4x200, press Space as your teammate hits the yellow go mark, then press it again to hand off. Field events: 3 attempts each. Build speed with ← →, take off at the board, and time the rings and meters with Space. High jump and pole vault: 3 misses and you're out.
  • Basketball & Soccer: quick matches from the main menu, or pickup games in career. Shift sprints, Space passes (or switches player on defense), K shoots: hold it and let go at the top of the meter for a green release (soccer: the longer you hold, the harder the shot). J steals or tackles, F does a crossover or skill move, Q lobs, E plays a through ball.
  • Career track season: after cross country each year, pick up to 4 events. Top 4 at League Finals go to CCS, and the top 3 at CCS go to the CIF State meet.
  • Career: build your own runner from 60 overall, pick a school and difficulty, and race four seasons chasing a spot at the State meet in Fresno. Go solo with computer teammates, or start an online team with friends.
  • Every race earns credits: better places, beating your seed, new personal bests, bad weather and daily streaks all pay more. Spend them in the Shop and the Mythic vault.
  • Team career: every meet is raced live as a team. The captain opens the start line, teammates tap “I'm ready,” and everyone races at the same time. Captains can switch regular meets back to racing on your own time in the team settings; League Finals, CCS and States are always live.
  • Career people: talk to your coach any time for advice. Max Nyden, the varsity senior on your team, says you'll never take his spot, so prove him wrong by finishing ahead of him before he graduates after your sophomore year.
  • Nike Cross Nationals: in career, the top 2 teams at the CIF State meet and the top 5 runners from every other team go on to Nationals at Glendoveer in Portland, against the best programs in the country. In team career, a qualified team races it live. Glendoveer is also a quick-race and 1v1 course.
  • College recruiting: if you're good enough, college coaches call at the end of junior year, and everyone hears from colleges at the start of senior year. Meet them, get offers, and commit before you graduate.
  • Pickup games: basketball and soccer, in solo and team career, just for fun. In team career the captain hosts and teammates join live. Move with WASD or the arrows, Space passes (or calls for the ball, or steals), K shoots (or blocks).
  • Team career workouts: the captain can host a team workout that teammates join live, for +1 on the gain.
  • Career training: during the season you get 3 track workouts (400s for kick, 1Ks for endurance, tempo for potential). Hit the target pace on each rep for the biggest gain.
  • Offseason easy runs can't be skipped. Set your own pace with push and ease, but running hard uses energy.
  • Team offseason: run solo, or start a group run that teammates join live. Running together adds +1.
  • 1v1: host a live race and send up to 5 friends the code. Race as any quick-race runner or one of your career runners.
  • Track: pick the Track tab on the course screen for the 800 m up to the 10,000 m on a 400 m oval. Stay on the rail: running wide on the bends costs ground. The 800 starts in lanes until the break line. Runners race at their real PRs where we have them, and estimates otherwise.
  • Maps: build your own course for 2,000 credits, then race it solo or with friends using its code. Nominate it, and the most-liked maps can be added to the game for up to a week.
  • Leaderboard: the fastest time anyone has run on each course. Sign in with an online account and your bests post there automatically.
  • Harvest Pass (Nov 9 – Dec 20): every finished race earns XP toward 30 levels, plus 3 daily quests and 3 weekly challenges. The free track pays everyone. Unlock the premium track for 5,000 credits for gear, mythics, Galaxy Rohan and the Nike Pegasus 42 at level 30. Thanksgiving Day is double XP.
  • Turkey Trot: during the Harvest Pass, pick it on the course screen for a 5K road race with a big field in costume.
  • Spend credits on overall upgrades for any standard runner, or buy 3 quick races as a 99-overall mythic.
  • The Shop sells racing shoes and weather gear that make you faster in every mode, career included.
  • P pauses, M mutes. Phones get on-screen buttons.
